title: Fixture alpha: writes
_note: test fixture (server/test/keyideas*.test.ts): unit keys kx/a/* are created by the tests

ideas.idea: A retried write must not apply twice: store the idempotency key with the result in one transaction.
ideas.why: A client retry after a timeout charges the customer twice.
ideas.prompt: A payment POST times out and the client retries. What makes the second request safe?
ideas.answer: The server stores the idempotency key and the result in the same transaction, then answers a repeat key with the stored result instead of writing again.

ideas.idea: Two read-modify-write requests lose one update unless a version column or a conditional UPDATE catches it.
ideas.why: The last writer silently overwrites the first.
ideas.prompt: Two tabs save the same record at once. How does the second save learn it is stale?
ideas.answer: A version column checked in the UPDATE's WHERE clause: zero rows updated means someone else saved first.

ideas.idea: Page by a unique, ordered key, not OFFSET.
ideas.why: OFFSET skips or repeats rows when rows are inserted between pages.
ideas.prompt: Why does page 3 repeat a row after an insert on page 1?
ideas.answer: OFFSET counts positions, and an insert shifts them; a keyset (WHERE id > last) does not move.
